name: Prospect Prediction Markets Inc.
summary: Prospect Prediction Markets Inc. specializes in developing and managing digital platforms for marketing and promotional activities aimed at retailers and other businesses. Their primary offering, the DeepMarkit platform, provides a range of tools and services centered around game-driven experiences, facilitating various promotional models such as sweepstakes, giveaways, and contests. The company also operates MintCarbon.io, a web-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform that enables the conversion of carbon credits into non-fungible tokens (NFTs). Initially incorporated in 2007 and based in Calgary, Canada, the company previously operated as Challenger Deep Resources Corp. before rebranding as DeepMarkit Corp. in October 2015.
